label: Data quality culture — a
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] have rules and processes to achieve quality (according to this document) taking into account the data quality model as applied to the applicable products and services

label: Data quality culture — b
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] define and implement data quality management processes, and performing related data quality activities

label: Data quality culture — c
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] integrate the data quality management processes and activities, to the extent appropriate, into other management processes and activities, such as general quality management and risk management

label: Data quality culture — d
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] document the performed activities

label: Data quality culture — e
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] provide resources sufficient to perform data quality management

label: Data quality culture — f
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] monitor, and to the extent necessary, review and improve the data quality management processes

label: Data quality culture — g
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] provide the required authority to involved personnel

label: Data quality culture — h
definition: [The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall:] communicate data quality policies within the organization

label: DQ issues management — a
definition: [The organization shall meet data quality requirements. The organization shall:] have processes for communicating, analysing, evaluating, resolving and closing (implementing a resolution or giving a reason for not being an unreasonable risk) issues of data quality

label: DQ issues management — b
definition: [The organization shall meet data quality requirements. The organization shall:] document closed issues

label: DQ issues management — c
definition: [The organization shall meet data quality requirements. The organization shall:] escalate issues that cannot be closed

label: Competence management — a
definition: [The organization shall manage competence. The organization shall:] document required skills and tools to process the data

label: Competence management — b
definition: [The organization shall manage competence. The organization shall:] ensure that involved persons have sufficient skills to perform their activities and duties

label: Competence management — c
definition: [The organization shall manage competence. The organization shall:] maintain proof of sufficient skill with the data quality system

label: Competence management — d
definition: [The organization shall manage competence. The organization shall:] keep appropriate records of training and experience that substantiate claims of competency

label: Resource management — a
definition: [The organization shall provide the resources required for data quality management, including:] appropriate software licenses and technical support for required tools

label: Resource management — b
definition: [The organization shall provide the resources required for data quality management, including:] required IT infrastructure or services to meet the storage and compute requirements

label: Resource management — c
definition: [The organization shall provide the resources required for data quality management, including:] availability of skilled persons

label: DQ audit — a
definition: [The implemented processes shall be audited. The audit shall:] evaluate the data quality plan against the organizational rules and processes for data quality

label: DQ audit — b
definition: [The implemented processes shall be audited. The audit shall:] determine whether planned activities have been implemented and maintained effectively

label: DQ audit — c
definition: [The implemented processes shall be audited. The audit shall:] identify non-compliances and propose corrective actions

label: DQ audit — d
definition: [The implemented processes shall be audited. The audit shall:] document audit findings and conclusions

label: DQ audit — e
definition: [The implemented processes shall be audited. The audit shall:] communicate findings to relevant stakeholders

label: Confirmation review — a
definition: [Data quality shall be confirmed. All work products shall undergo confirmation reviews that:] confirm that work products meet the data specification

label: Confirmation review — b
definition: [Data quality shall be confirmed. All work products shall undergo confirmation reviews that:] confirm that data quality measures have been applied correctly

label: Confirmation review — c
definition: [Data quality shall be confirmed. All work products shall undergo confirmation reviews that:] identify any remaining open issues

label: Confirmation review — d
definition: [Data quality shall be confirmed. All work products shall undergo confirmation reviews that:] authorise progression to the next life cycle stage

label: Project-specific DQM — a
definition: [The organization shall manage project-specific data. The organization shall:] establish a suitable project-specific DQM process

label: Project-specific DQM — b
definition: [The organization shall manage project-specific data. The organization shall:] maintain a list of relevant DQ claims with benchmarks for each milestone

label: Project-specific DQM — c
definition: [The organization shall manage project-specific data. The organization shall:] adopt processes to identify and manage all relevant DQ measures

label: Data motivation — a
definition: [The organization shall complete data motivation and conceptualization. The organization shall:] document motivation and origin of the data need

label: Data motivation — b
definition: [The organization shall complete data motivation and conceptualization. The organization shall:] specify scope, purpose and intended use of data

label: Data motivation — c
definition: [The organization shall complete data motivation and conceptualization. The organization shall:] document the data quality requirements

label: Stakeholder analysis — a
definition: [The organization shall conduct stakeholder analysis. The organization shall:] identify all stakeholders relevant to the data and the intended use

label: Stakeholder analysis — b
definition: [The organization shall conduct stakeholder analysis. The organization shall:] document stakeholder data quality requirements and expectations

label: Data format — a
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] the data type(s) of each data item

label: Data format — b
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] the allowed range or set of values for each data item

label: Data format — c
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] the encoding and representation standards

label: Data format — d
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] the unit of measurement for quantitative data items

label: Data format — e
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] the definition of missing or null values

label: Data format — f
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] any required data structure (e.g. tabular, hierarchical, graph)

label: Data format — g
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] inter-data constraints and integrity rules

label: Data format — h
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] metadata requirements

label: Data format — i
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] versioning and provenance requirements

label: Data format — j
definition: [The data specification shall include the following format specifications:] any other format constraints relevant to intended use

label: Data planning — a
definition: [The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers:] the processes, activities and resources required to meet the data specification throughout the data life cycle

label: Data planning — b
definition: [The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers:] entry and exit criteria for each DQMLC stage

label: Data planning — c
definition: [The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers:] the data quality measures to be applied

label: Data planning — d
definition: [The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers:] responsibilities and authorities for DQM activities

label: Data planning — e
definition: [The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers:] schedule and milestones for DQM activities

label: Life cycle plans — a
definition: [The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing:] data acquisition plan

label: Life cycle plans — b
definition: [The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing:] data preprocessing plan

label: Life cycle plans — c
definition: [The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing:] data augmentation plan

label: Life cycle plans — d
definition: [The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing:] data provisioning plan

label: Life cycle plans — e
definition: [The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing:] data decommissioning plan

label: Data collection — a
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] reasons for collection, including the relationship to the data specification

label: Data collection — b
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] the method of data collection

label: Data collection — c
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] the data collection specification including data item descriptions

label: Data collection — d
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] required resources and skills for data collection

label: Data collection — e
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] anonymisation or pseudonymisation methods where applicable

label: Data collection — f
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] measurement scales and units

label: Data collection — g
definition: [The organization shall document data collection. The organization shall document:] expected deviations from the data specification and their justification

label: Data cleaning — a
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] missing data items

label: Data cleaning — b
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] duplication

label: Data cleaning — c
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] outliers

label: Data cleaning — d
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] bias and drift

label: Data cleaning — e
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] non-standard or invalid data values

label: Data cleaning — f
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] unneeded or irrelevant data items

label: Data cleaning — g
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] required transformations

label: Data cleaning — h
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] verification that cleaning results meet the data specification

label: Data cleaning — i
definition: [The organization shall specify data quality measures for cleaning, including measures for:] de-identification or anonymisation where applicable

label: Data provisioning — a
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] specify data provisioning processes to meet the data specification

label: Data provisioning — b
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] provide auditable evidence that provisioned data meets all specified data quality requirements

label: Data provisioning — c
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] ensure that the provisioning process does not alter the data beyond what is specified

label: Data provisioning — d
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] document all provisioning activities

label: Data provisioning — e
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] maintain a record of all data provisioned, including version and provenance information

label: Data provisioning — f
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] ensure that recipients are authorised to receive the provisioned data

label: Data provisioning — g
definition: [The organization shall specify data provisioning processes. The organization shall:] ensure that provisioning complies with applicable legal and contractual obligations

label: Provisioning docs — a
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] scope of use and intended purpose

label: Provisioning docs — b
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] instructions for use

label: Provisioning docs — c
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] statistical properties of the dataset

label: Provisioning docs — d
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] description of each data item

label: Provisioning docs — e
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] list of stakeholders and their roles

label: Provisioning docs — f
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] duties and obligations of the recipient

label: Provisioning docs — g
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] use environment requirements

label: Provisioning docs — h
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] quality factors and their measurement results

label: Provisioning docs — i
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] acceptance test methods

label: Provisioning docs — j
definition: [Documentation provisioned with data shall include:] communication strategy for updates and issue reporting

label: Data optimization — a
definition: [The organization shall specify data optimization processes that:] reduce storage and computational overhead without reducing quality below specified thresholds

label: Data optimization — b
definition: [The organization shall specify data optimization processes that:] apply only transformations that are documented and reversible or justified

label: Data optimization — c
definition: [The organization shall specify data optimization processes that:] validate that optimised data still meets the data specification

label: Data optimization — d
definition: [The organization shall specify data optimization processes that:] maintain a record of all optimisation operations applied

label: Support commitment — a
definition: [The organization shall document all support commitments in a support agreement that covers:] scope of support

label: Support commitment — b
definition: [The organization shall document all support commitments in a support agreement that covers:] response times and service levels

label: Support commitment — c
definition: [The organization shall document all support commitments in a support agreement that covers:] versioning and update policy

label: Support commitment — d
definition: [The organization shall document all support commitments in a support agreement that covers:] conditions for withdrawal of data

label: Change request spec — a
definition: [Each change request shall specify:] the data item or process affected

label: Change request spec — b
definition: [Each change request shall specify:] the reason for the change

label: Change request spec — c
definition: [Each change request shall specify:] the proposed change

label: Change request spec — d
definition: [Each change request shall specify:] the requestor and date

label: Change request analysis — a
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] impact on data quality

label: Change request analysis — b
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] impact on dependent datasets, processes and plans

label: Change request analysis — c
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] risks introduced by the change

label: Change request analysis — d
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] alternative solutions

label: Change request analysis — e
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] resources required

label: Change request analysis — f
definition: [Change requests shall be analysed to determine:] impact on schedule

label: Change request eval — a
definition: [Change requests shall be evaluated and:] approved, with conditions if necessary

label: Change request eval — b
definition: [Change requests shall be evaluated and:] deferred to a later stage

label: Change request eval — c
definition: [Change requests shall be evaluated and:] rejected with justification

label: DQ tools — a
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] approved tool list with version information

label: DQ tools — b
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] tool qualification and validation

label: DQ tools — c
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] access control and licensing

label: DQ tools — d
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] backup and recovery

label: DQ tools — e
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] monitoring of tool-induced data quality issues

label: DQ tools — f
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] tool change management

label: DQ tools — g
definition: [The organization shall manage data processing tools covering:] documentation of tool-specific data quality constraints

label: DQ dependencies — a
definition: [The organization shall manage data quality dependencies by:] identifying all data quality dependencies between datasets and processes

label: DQ dependencies — b
definition: [The organization shall manage data quality dependencies by:] documenting the impact of dependency failures on data quality

label: DQ dependencies — c
definition: [The organization shall manage data quality dependencies by:] specifying mitigation strategies for dependency-related quality risks
